items.title: Phone sign-in
items.description: Return to your account with phone-based sign-in and the configured verification method.
items.capture: Capture the sign-in screen with a fictional phone number. Record 10–15 seconds from the prepared form to Home using a demo account; omit passwords and verification codes.
items.notes: Sign-in may send a real WhatsApp verification message; use a controlled demo account.

items.title: Create your hiker profile
items.description: Set your name, hiking experience, frequency and residential city.
items.capture: Capture the profile form and city-level map picker as onboarding.png and onboarding-city.png. Record scrolling through the fields without revealing a password or exact home address.

items.title: Login security
items.description: Review Authenticator and supported passkey methods for account protection.
items.capture: Refresh the Login security overview using a demo account. Capture only the methods list, never setup QR codes, secret keys or one-time codes.
items.notes: Existing website media; recorded before this showcase. Interface may differ from the current build. Native iOS passkeys require supported signing; Personal Team builds use Authenticator.

items.title: Account recovery
items.description: Recover access and review the extra verification used for sensitive account changes.
items.capture: Capture the recovery entry and method selection in a test account. A short recording may show navigation only; stop before requesting codes or changing credentials.

items.title: Trusted contacts
items.description: Choose up to three people who can receive your emergency messages.
items.capture: Capture three fictional contacts with relationships and an open editor. Use a demo repository or controlled test account; do not show real numbers or change production contacts.

items.title: Find your next trail
items.description: Browse trails and narrow choices by region or distance.
items.capture: Capture the current Home trail list, then record 15–20 seconds selecting a filter and opening a trail.
items.notes: Existing website media; recorded before this showcase. Interface may differ from the current build.

items.title: A trail at a glance
items.description: See trail imagery, distance, elevation, expected time and community difficulty.
items.capture: Capture the trail hero with real loaded imagery and metrics; record a slow scroll through route and checkpoint sections.
items.notes: Existing website media; recorded before this showcase. Interface may differ from the current build.

items.title: Follow the route before departure
items.description: Explore route geometry, ordered checkpoints and the animated first-person preview.
items.capture: Record 20–30 seconds of the current route map, one highlighted checkpoint and first-person playback. Include the rain estimate label if available.
items.notes: Existing website screenshot. A new recording is needed for the current first-person controls.

items.title: Choose a weather window
items.description: Compare forecast days, hourly conditions, daylight and weather cautions.
items.capture: Capture the expanded forecast and record changing day/metric, selecting an hour and reading cautions.
items.notes: Existing website media; recorded before this showcase. Interface may differ from the current build.

items.title: Weather on the map
items.description: Overlay regional rain, wind or temperature while keeping the trail route visible.
items.capture: Capture rain, wind and temperature overlays after loading, named weather-map.png, weather-map-wind.png and weather-map-temperature.png. Record 15 seconds changing layer and opacity.
items.notes: Requires configured weather service. Regional layers are not measurements at every point on the trail.

items.title: Community trail cautions
items.description: Review reported hazards and describe a caution at a trail location.
items.capture: Capture the category picker and a prepared report with sample text. Record navigation without submitting a false live hazard.
items.notes: Existing website capture. Submitting a report writes community data.

items.title: Your next hike
items.description: See departure timing, current difficulty, forecast and preparation progress together.
items.capture: Capture the current Next Hike card with date, departure/return, difficulty and preparation action. Record the countdown briefly; use a planned demo hike.
items.notes: Rendered interface preview using demo data; not a new phone capture. Shows the Next Hike card in isolation; capture the full Home carousel for the complete experience.

items.title: Solo or team
items.description: Choose your hiking mode and select a route for the outing.
items.capture: Capture solo/team selection and record 15–20 seconds choosing a mode and trail without starting a real session.
items.notes: Existing website capture. Longer routes apply HikerCircle-specific solo distance rules.

items.title: Build the itinerary
items.description: Review checkpoint order and adjust the planned stops.
items.capture: Capture the current checkpoint timeline and map picker. Record highlighting a stop and returning to its place in the route.
items.notes: Use a demo draft; do not save modifications to shared production trails.

items.title: Timing & reminders
items.description: Start now or schedule an outing with check-in and preparation reminders.
items.capture: Capture date/time and reminder controls. Record a prepared demo schedule without sending team invitations.
items.notes: Existing website capture.

items.title: Safety before departure
items.description: Review live sharing, fall and stillness monitoring, and route-deviation alerts.
items.capture: Capture the current safety settings and record changing a demo draft's sensitivity and rest settings.
items.notes: Existing website media; recorded before this showcase. Interface may differ from the current build. Warning behavior is platform-specific; the screenshot does not validate detection reliability.

items.title: One packing question at a time
items.description: Pack the required items for the route and understand why each item matters.
flow: Choose Yes, packed or Not yet
items.capture: Capture the current Get ready to hike required-item question showing its reason and response buttons. Record 15 seconds answering two items in a demo plan.
items.notes: Rendered interface preview using demo data; not a new phone capture. Current guided flow supersedes older preparation tabs. A saved tick records the answer, not physical verification.

items.title: Extras, safety & final review
items.description: Review optional gear, contacts, battery, sharing and conditions before the final start check.
items.capture: Provide preparation-review.png at final review plus preparation-extras.png and preparation-safety.png. Record 20–30 seconds through extras, a safety prompt and a blocked/ready final state in a demo plan.
items.notes: Rendered interface preview using demo data; not a new phone capture.

items.title: Get everyone ready
items.description: Coordinate team preparation, participant readiness and a shared departure.
items.capture: Record host and participant readiness with controlled demo accounts. Capture the roster and shared countdown; use isolated test sessions.
items.notes: Existing website media; recorded before this showcase. Interface may differ from the current build. Starting creates an active session and may notify invited participants.

items.title: Your active hike
items.description: Follow the route with elapsed time, recorded positions and safety status.
items.capture: Capture the current full-map active Home with status strip and bottom controls. Record a short controlled walk or simulated demo movement.
items.notes: Existing website capture. GPS and background behavior depend on platform, permissions and app state.

items.title: Check in & save a place
items.description: Record a check-in or mark a point worth returning to.
items.capture: Record one check-in and one pin in an isolated demo hike; capture confirmation with a non-sensitive location.

items.title: Stay aware of your team
items.description: Review teammate positions, check-ins and route or separation notices.
items.capture: Capture Team Tools with at least two test participants and a timestamped map. Record switching between roster/check-ins and the map.
items.notes: Use controlled participants. Stale updates and route warnings do not prove an emergency.

items.title: Conditions & optional live sharing
items.description: Review weather along the hike and manage a location link for trusted people.
items.capture: Capture active weather and Location sharing as active-weather-sharing.png and location-sharing.png. Record only demo link controls; use a test location and stop sharing afterward.
items.notes: Creating a live link exposes its location to people holding that link; use a demo session.

items.title: Emergency controls
items.description: Keep manual, medical and discreet duress actions within reach.
items.capture: Capture the current SOS page while idle, including mode guidance. Use the isolated showcase entry point for any activated state.
items.notes: Existing website capture. Production SOS can message contacts and activate sound, vibration or flashlight.

items.title: Time to cancel a manual alert
items.description: A manual SOS countdown offers a chance to cancel before contact dispatch.
items.capture: Record a 10–15 second manual countdown and cancellation using lib/showcase_safety_main.dart or another isolated no-dispatch harness. Capture countdown at five seconds.
items.notes: Do not demonstrate against live emergency contacts. Cancelling before dispatch differs from stopping a local alarm afterward.

items.title: A discreet duress demonstration
items.description: A staged example shows the duress interface and sample contact result.
items.capture: For a replacement, record only the no-dispatch showcase build with fictional contacts. Show widget entry, mode and result in 15 seconds.
items.notes: Existing staged demonstration with sample contacts. It does not establish real WhatsApp delivery or invisible operation.

items.title: Clear alert status & notes
items.description: Review queued alerts, per-contact outcomes and optional emergency message notes.
items.capture: Provide sos-queue-notes.png showing a seeded queued/partial alert and sos-notes.png showing fictional text. Record inspecting details in an isolated demo; never enqueue a real SOS for media.

items.title: Pair a physical SOS button
items.description: Discover a button, confirm ownership and review its monitoring readiness.
items.capture: Record guided pairing with the owner's test hardware and capture the paired ready state. Keep device secrets and identifiers out of close-up exports.
items.notes: Existing website media; recorded before this showcase. Interface may differ from the current build. Button operation depends on the phone/app and supported firmware.

items.title: Safe button tests & event history
items.description: Check a paired button using its armed test mode and read its event log.
items.capture: Capture the Test mode active and Button press detected states, then event history with identifiers removed. Record only an authenticated mode-0x02 test inside its active arm window.
items.notes: Ordinary physical presses can trigger production SOS. Do not use an unarmed button press as a demo.

items.title: Nearby SOS context
items.description: Inspect nearby reported incidents and their available location context.
items.capture: Capture a seeded incident list and map as nearby-help.png and nearby-help-map.png. Use repository fixtures; do not broadcast a fake live emergency.
items.notes: Nearby observations are not verified rescue responses. Test phone broadcasts can reach other devices.

items.title: Prepared guidance
items.description: Browse first-aid topics, offline tutorial media and the standalone gear checklist.
items.capture: Capture a guide topic and current checklist. Record 15–20 seconds browsing guidance and offline video controls; do not dial emergency services.
items.notes: Existing website capture. Use app guidance as presented; emergency dialing and Open SOS are real actions.

items.title: Meet your hiking circle
items.description: Browse community hikers and review public profiles before connecting.
items.capture: Capture discovery and a consenting/demo public profile; record navigation without sending unsolicited requests.
items.notes: Existing website media; recorded before this showcase. Interface may differ from the current build.

items.title: Discover & join a group
items.description: Explore scheduled group hikes and follow open or approval-based joining.
items.capture: Capture one open group and one approval-required group using test hosts. Record request and acceptance only with controlled consenting demo accounts.

items.title: Stories & buddies
items.description: Read hike stories, connect with other hikers and review buddy requests.
items.capture: Provide stories-buddies.png with sample stories and buddy-requests.png. Record scrolling and request review; do not publish posts or send requests to real users for the capture.

items.title: Conversations around the hike
items.description: Use direct or group conversations with attachments and notification controls.
items.capture: Capture a consented demo chat and attachment picker. Record navigation through image/video/document options and mute settings without transmitting a real message.

items.title: Close the hike & rate the route
items.description: End a session, confirm the team outcome and share route difficulty feedback.
items.capture: Capture the completion summary and route rating. Record ending an isolated test hike only; avoid changing real hike histories or ratings.
items.notes: Existing website capture. Completing or rating a live hike writes account/community records.

items.title: Your hike history
items.description: Revisit completed hikes and expired plans with their saved route details.
items.capture: Capture the current completed/expired navigation and a populated demo list. Record opening one completed hike.
items.notes: Existing website media; recorded before this showcase. Interface may differ from the current build.

items.title: The details of your day
items.description: Review recorded distance, pace, checkpoints, safety events and the original plan.
items.capture: Capture overview and pace/checkpoint analysis as hike-analysis.png and hike-analysis-pace.png. Record switching the history tabs with demo data.
items.notes: Existing website media; recorded before this showcase. Interface may differ from the current build.

items.title: Replay & share the journey
items.description: Revisit team movement and prepare a shareable hike recap.
items.capture: Capture team replay and the recap preview, then record 15–20 seconds of playback. Stop at the system share chooser; no external posting is required.

items.title: Progress worth revisiting
items.description: Explore achievements, hiking levels, the level roadmap and leaderboard.
items.capture: Capture current Achievements, level roadmap and a consenting/demo leaderboard. Record switching status and period controls.
items.notes: Existing website media; recorded before this showcase. Interface may differ from the current build.

items.title: Your profile & preferences
items.description: Manage profile details, profile QR, appearance, language and device notifications.
items.capture: Provide profile-settings.png, profile-qr.png and app-settings.png with a fictional account. Record theme/language controls and notification history without private messages.

items.title: Prepare for limited coverage
items.description: Manage the Malaysia offline map, cached guidance and app storage.
items.capture: Capture offline download/status and storage usage. Record opening already downloaded guidance without connectivity; downloading may use network data.
items.notes: Offline resources do not imply offline contact-message delivery. Verify availability on the captured build.

items.title: Feedback with context
items.description: Capture a screen, mark the issue and review feedback before sending.
items.capture: Capture annotation mode and final review with harmless demo text. Record drawing and reviewing; use seeded My feedback for status examples instead of submitting a live report.

items.title: Administration workspace
items.description: Review the trail library, safety reports, community content and achievement rules.
items.capture: Capture the current mobile admin overview and one collection. Use a demo administrator dataset; crop all real user data and do not approve, remove or edit live records.
items.notes: Rendered interface preview using demo data; not a new phone capture. Collection counts shown are sample data.

items.title: Maintain trail & community quality
items.description: Inspect trail editing, route checkpoints and moderation decisions.
items.capture: Provide admin-trails-moderation.png for a trail draft and admin-review-queue.png for seeded moderation. Record editor/navigation without saving, deleting, approving or hiding live content.

items.title: Support & button diagnostics
items.description: Review feedback, decoded button events and cloud or local diagnostics.
items.capture: Capture sanitized feedback inbox and Button Debugging screens, named admin-feedback.png and admin-diagnostics.png. Record a safe armed button test using test hardware; exclude payload secrets and personal records.
items.notes: Diagnostics may contain raw packets, account data or identifiers; inspect every exported frame.

items.title: Widgets & Live Activity
items.description: Earlier captures show hike status and safety entry points outside the open app.
items.capture: Refresh with current widgets: capture the upcoming-hikes widget and an active Live Activity using a demo account. Avoid activating SOS actions on the production build.
items.notes: Historical/staged presentation. Platform behavior and background reliability must be validated separately.

items.title: The original safety interface
items.description: An archived view records the early emergency-control design.
items.capture: No replacement required for this archive item. Supply a dated original capture only if adding another historical version.
items.notes: Historical interface, labeled 28 May 2026 in existing website metadata; not the current product screen.
